comments.author: DiNozzo
comments.body:
Excel calculation shows that average cost for a G1 Large Carrack is
about 15.68 million, so 10 sheets of "Large Ship Blueprint Part" is
16.58 mil including dismantle cost 0.9 mil.
As "Large Ship Blueprint" is composed of 100 sheets of parts, the
price will become at least 165.8 million after they consume the sheets
from event prize.

comments.author: DiNozzo
comments.body:
Here is the data I adopted for calc.

p_n: success rate in n-th trial (n begins with zero)
A_n: total cost incurred up to n-th trial using Large Carrack

p_0=p_1=0.38, p_2=0.39, p_n=0.38+0.01(n-1) for n>1
A_0=7.2, A_1=7.2+5.4, A_2=7.2+10.8, A_n=7.2+5.4n (million)

Probabilty that reaches n-th trial is
(1-p_0)(1-p_1)*...*(1-p_{n-1}) for n>0 (unity for n=0),
therefore, probabilty that SR succeeded at n-th trial is
(1-p_0)(1-p_1)*...*(1-p_{n-1})p_n for n>0 (p_0 for n=0).

Hope my calc is correct.
